Madravati.note: A princess of Madra; wife of Parikshit and mother of Janamejaya.

Dyutimanta.note: King of Madra; father of Shalya and Madri.

Shalya.note: King of Madra, brother of Madri; a peerless charioteer tricked into fighting for Duryodhana, whom he served as Karna's charioteer. Marching to join the Pandavas, was waylaid with lavish hospitality by disguised Duryodhana's men and, bound by a promise of gratitude given before he knew who had given it, forced to fight for the Kauravas instead; drove Karna's chariot needling him with doubt through his last battle, then took command of the whole army after Karna fell and was killed by Yudhishthira himself, the one Kaurava commander the eldest Pandava faced in person.

Madri.note: Princess of Madra; second wife of Pandu and mother, by the Ashvins, of the twins Nakula and Sahadeva. She followed Pandu onto his pyre.

people.Rukmangada: Son of Shalya of Madra, slain in the war.
people.Rukmaratha: Son of Shalya of Madra, slain in the war.

MadraKing.name: Madra
MadraKing.note: Son of Shibi, and the king from whom Madra takes its name. SB 9.23.3

AshvapatiMadra.name: Ashvapati
AshvapatiMadra.note: King of Madra; long sonless, he propitiated the goddess Savitri for eighteen years and was given a daughter, whom he named for her. Not Ashvapati of Kekaya, Kaikeyi's father. MBh 3.277.

Savitri.note: Daughter of Ashvapati of Madra; chose the exiled prince Satyavan for herself knowing, from the sage Narada, that he had exactly one year to live, and married him anyway. When Yama himself came for Satyavan's soul, she followed him on foot into death, answered his questions on dharma so well he granted her boons — sight for Satyavan's blind father, his kingdom back, a hundred sons for herself — and, tricked at last into asking for Satyavan's own life among them, won her husband back by the letter of Yama's own word. MBh 3.277-283.

Satyavan.note: Son of the blind, exiled king Dyumatsena of Shalva; husband of Savitri, who married him knowing he was fated to die within the year. Died of a sudden pain in the head exactly on the day foretold, in the forest, his head in Savitri's lap; brought back when she out-argued Yama himself. MBh 3.277-283.

unions.note: Madra's line runs unnamed down to Dyutimanta, father of Shalya and Madri. SB 9.23.3
Savitri chose him at her own svayamvara-equivalent, over her father's objection, knowing Narada's forecast of his death within the year. MBh 3.277-283.
